Live Music: Bryan Odeen

Description
Enjoy an evening of live music with Bryan Odeen at Fat Hill Brewing on Friday, November 6th, at 7 PM. A Midwestern native raised on the music of Johnny Cash, John Denver, and Bob Dylan, Bryan brings a blend of country, folk, rock, and gospel influences to the stage. Enjoy familiar tunes and discover a few new favorites along the way! There is no admission fee. For more information, visit https://www.facebook.com/events/986739231141689.

Fat Hill Brewing

17 North Federal Avenue, Mason City, IA 50401
